content:
Advertisements are coming to Apple Maps in the US and Canada, with merchants able to start booking ad slots from today. Here are the details, including limited-time promotional offers for merchants.

Merchants can book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you're a business owner looking to advertise on Apple Maps, the booking service officially opens today.

Users won't see the ads go live just yet, but Apple has opened up bookings for merchants first as it prepares for a full rollout.

The complete ad booking information has been uploaded to Apple's official website, with step-by-step details on how to get started.

Apple has also launched a special limited-time offer, with details as follows:

Eligible merchants who book a maps ad with credit card payment by October 11, 2026 can enjoy this offer.

According to Apple's earlier announcement, ads will appear in two locations on Apple Maps:

  • Before users search: the "Suggested Places" on the search screen will display business ads.
  • After users search: ads relevant to the search content will appear in the search results.

If you're considering advertising on Apple Maps, Apple's official website also has a dedicated page explaining their approach to handling ads, with details available here.
